# server

```go
import "budget2/cmd/server"
```

Command server is the SimpleBudget HTTP application. It boots the chi router, wires the dataloader / retirement / backup services into the handler packages, serves the dashboard and what\-if UI over HTMX, and installs the graceful\-shutdown signal handler that triggers a final backup snapshot before exit.
